name: ashlar/timeline
title: Timeline
description: The company’s story in milestones: the year, what happened and a line about it. Across the page on desktop, down a rail on mobile.

lede.default: From one van to two railway arches, with a few lessons learned the hard way.

default.title: One van, two of us
default.text: Our first job was a kitchen on Mildmay Grove. It came in £200 under the quote, and Priya still brings it up.

default.title: The first Friday report
default.text: A client’s mum lived in Leeds and asked for photos every week. We’ve sent every client one since.

default.title: The six-site rule
default.text: We took on eleven jobs at once and did none of them well. We haven’t run more than six since.

default.title: The yard
default.text: Two railway arches on Wharf Road: timber store, joinery shop and an office with a kettle that works.

default.title: Builder of the year
default.text: North London Homes Awards, under-50-staff category. The trophy holds the joinery shop door open.

default.title: House 118
default.text: Elm Row, handed over in week 22, the day we said it would be.
